1: // Simple Cosmic Courier game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
9:   // Simple audio context for sound effects
10:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
11:   function beep(freq, dur) {
12:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
13:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
14:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
15:     osc.type = 'sine';
16:     osc.connect(gain);
17:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
18:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
19:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
20:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
21:     osc.start(audioCtx.currentTime);
22:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
23:   }
24:   function playBoost(){ beep(440, 0.07); }
25:   function playCollect(){ beep(660, 0.12); }
26:   function playCollision(){ beep(200, 0.3); }
27:   function playGameOver(){ beep(150, 0.5); }
28: 
29:   const keys = {};
30:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
31:     keys[e.key] = true;
32:     // resume AudioContext on first interaction
33:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
34:   });
35:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
36: 
37:   const player = {
38:     x: canvas.width / 2,
39:     y: canvas.height - 50,
40:     r: 12,
41:     speed: 2,
42:     boostSpeed: 5,
43:     fuel: 100,
44:     boost: false,
45:     prevBoost: false,
46:   };
47: 
48:   const stars = [];
49:   const asteroids = [];
50:   const packages = [];
51:   let gameOver = false;
52:   const soundFlags = { gameOver: false };
53:   let score = 0;
54:   // background star spawn
55:   function spawnStar(){
56:     stars.push({x: rand(0, canvas.width), y: -2, size: rand(0.5,2), vy: rand(0.5,1.5)});
57:   }
58: 
59:   function rand(min, max) { return Math.random() * (max - min) + min; }
60:   function spawnAsteroid() {
61:     const size = rand(10, 30);
62:     asteroids.push({
63:       x: rand(0, canvas.width),
64:       y: -size,
65:       r: size,
66:       vy: rand(1, 3),
67:     });
68:   }
69:   function spawnPackage() {
70:     const size = 8;
71:     packages.push({
72:       x: rand(0, canvas.width),
73:       y: -size,
74:       r: size,
75:       vy: rand(1, 2),
76:     });
77:   }
78: 
79:   function update() {
80:     if (gameOver) return;
81:     // Player movement
82:     const moving = {x: 0, y: 0};
83:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) moving.x -= 1;
84:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) moving.x += 1;
85:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) moving.y -= 1;
86:     if (keys['ArrowDown']) moving.y += 1;
87:     const norm = Math.hypot(moving.x, moving.y) || 1;
88:     const spd = (keys[' '] && player.fuel > 0) ? player.boostSpeed : player.speed;
89:     player.boost = keys[' '] && player.fuel > 0;
90:     // Boost sound on transition
91:     if (player.boost && !player.prevBoost) playBoost();
92:     player.prevBoost = player.boost;
93:     if (player.boost) player.fuel = Math.max(0, player.fuel - 0.3);
94:     player.x += (moving.x / norm) * spd;
95:     player.y += (moving.y / norm) * spd;
96:     // Keep inside canvas
97:     player.x = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(canvas.width - player.r, player.x));
98:     player.y = Math.max(player.r, Math.min(canvas.height - player.r, player.y));
99: 
100:     // Spawn entities
101:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
102:     if (Math.random() < 0.01) spawnPackage();
103:     if (Math.random() < 0.05) spawnStar(); // background stars
104: 
105:     // Move entities
106:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.y += a.vy);
107:     packages.forEach(p => p.y += p.vy);
108:     stars.forEach(s => s.y += s.vy);
109:     // Remove off‑screen
110:     while (asteroids.length && asteroids[0].y - asteroids[0].r > canvas.height) asteroids.shift();
111:     while (packages.length && packages[0].y - packages[0].r > canvas.height) packages.shift();
112:     while (stars.length && stars[0].y > canvas.height) stars.shift();
113: 
114:     // Collision detection
115:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
116:       const a = asteroids[i];
117:       const dx = a.x - player.x, dy = a.y - player.y;
118:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < a.r + player.r) {
119:         if (!soundFlags.gameOver) { playCollision(); soundFlags.gameOver = true; }
120:         gameOver = true; break;
121:       }
122:     }
123:     for (let i = packages.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
124:       const p = packages[i];
125:       const dx = p.x - player.x, dy = p.y - player.y;
126:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < p.r + player.r) { score++; packages.splice(i, 1); playCollect(); }
127:     }
128:     if (player.fuel <= 0) {
129:       if (!soundFlags.gameOver) { playGameOver(); soundFlags.gameOver = true; }
130:       gameOver = true;
131:     }
132:   }
133: 
134: function draw() {
135:     // Background gradient (deep space)
136:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
137:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
138:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
139:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
140:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
141: 
142:     // Stars (tiny white points)
143:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
144:     stars.forEach(s => {
145:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.size, s.size);
146:     });
147: 
148:     // Player ship (triangle with gradient)
149:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, player.y - player.r, 0, player.y + player.r);
150:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0ff');
151:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#005');
152:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
153:     ctx.beginPath();
154:     ctx.moveTo(player.x, player.y - player.r);
155:     ctx.lineTo(player.x - player.r, player.y + player.r);
156:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.r, player.y + player.r);
157:     ctx.closePath();
158:     ctx.fill();
159:     // Asteroids (rocky gradient)
160:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
161:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.3, a.x, a.y, a.r);
162:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbb');
163:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
164:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
165:       ctx.beginPath();
166:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
167:       ctx.fill();
168:     });
169: 
170:     // Packages (small glowing squares)
171:     packages.forEach(p => {
172:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, p.r * 0.2, p.x, p.y, p.r);
173:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff0');
174:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#aa0');
175:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
176:       ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.r, p.y - p.r, p.r * 2, p.r * 2);
177:     });
178: 
179:     // HUD
180:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
181:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
182:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
183:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.floor(player.fuel)}`, 10, 40);
184:     if (gameOver) {
185:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
186:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
187:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
188:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
189:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
190:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
191:     }
192:   }
193:   }
194: 
195:   function loop() {
196:     update();
197:     draw();
198:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
199:   }
200:   loop();
